verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָוִ֥ד שִֽׁיר׃ תְהִלָּ֓ה דֻֽמִיָּ֬ה לְךָ֤ אֱלֹ֘הִ֥ים בְּצִיּ֑וֹן וּ֝לְךָ֗ נֶֽדֶר׃ יְשֻׁלַּם־
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ šîr ṯə·hil·lāh ḏu·mî·yāh lə·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·ṣî·yō·wn ū·lə·ḵā ne·ḏer yə·šul·lam-
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David A song Praise awaits You O God in Zion to You our vows will be fulfilled

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֥עַ תְּפִלָּ֑ה כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֥ר יָבֹֽאוּ׃ עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ
verses.literal: O You who listen to prayer all people will come to You

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹת גָּ֣בְרוּ מֶ֑נִּי אַתָּ֥ה תְכַפְּרֵֽם׃ פְּ֝שָׁעֵ֗ינוּ
verses.literal: When iniquities . . . prevail against me You atone for our transgressions

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י׀ תִּֽבְחַ֣ר וּתְקָרֵב֮ יִשְׁכֹּ֪ן חֲצֵ֫רֶ֥יךָ נִ֭שְׂבְּעָה בְּט֣וּב בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê tiḇ·ḥar ū·ṯə·qā·rêḇ yiš·kōn ḥă·ṣê·re·ḵā niś·bə·‘āh bə·ṭūḇ bê·ṯe·ḵā qə·ḏōš hê·ḵā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts We are filled with the goodness of Your house the holiness of Your temple

verses.original: נ֤וֹרָא֨וֹת׀ בְּצֶ֣דֶק תַּ֭עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ מִבְטָ֥ח כָּל־ קַצְוֵי־ אֶ֝֗רֶץ רְחֹקִֽים׃ וְיָ֣ם
verses.transliteration: nō·w·rā·’ō·wṯ bə·ṣe·ḏeq ta·‘ă·nê·nū ’ĕ·lō·hê yiš·‘ê·nū miḇ·ṭāḥ kāl- qaṣ·wê- ’e·reṣ rə·ḥō·qîm wə·yām
verses.literal: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us O God of our salvation the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas
You formed the mountains by Your power having girded Yourself with might

verses.original: מַשְׁבִּ֤יחַ׀ שְׁא֣וֹן יַ֭מִּים שְׁא֥וֹן גַּלֵּיהֶ֗ם וַהֲמ֥וֹן לְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: maš·bî·aḥ šə·’ō·wn yam·mîm šə·’ō·wn gal·lê·hem wa·hă·mō·wn lə·’um·mîm
verses.literal: You stilled the roaring of the seas the pounding of their waves and the tumult of the nations

verses.original: יֹשְׁבֵ֣י קְ֭צָוֺת וַיִּ֤ירְא֨וּ׀ מֵאוֹתֹתֶ֑יךָ מ֤וֹצָֽאֵי־ בֹ֖קֶר וָעֶ֣רֶב תַּרְנִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: yō·šə·ḇê qə·ṣā·wōṯ way·yî·rə·’ū mê·’ō·w·ṯō·ṯe·ḵā mō·w·ṣā·’ê- ḇō·qer wā·‘e·reḇ tar·nîn
verses.literal: Those who live far away fear Your wonders You make the dawn . . . and sunset shout for joy

verses.original: פָּקַ֥דְתָּ הָאָ֨רֶץ׀ וַתְּשֹׁ֪קְקֶ֡הָ רַבַּ֬ת תַּעְשְׁרֶ֗נָּה פֶּ֣לֶג אֱ֭לֹהִים מָ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם כִּי־ תָּכִ֥ין דְּ֝גָנָ֗ם תְּכִינֶֽהָ׃ כֵ֥ן
verses.transliteration: pā·qaḏ·tā hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tə·šō·qə·qe·hā rab·baṯ ta‘·šə·ren·nāh pe·leḡ ’ĕ·lō·hîm mā·lê mā·yim kî- tā·ḵîn də·ḡā·nām tə·ḵî·ne·hā ḵên
verses.literal: You attend to the earth and water it with abundance You enrich it The streams of God are full of water for You prepare our grain by providing for [the earth]

verses.original: רַ֭וֵּה תְּלָמֶ֣יהָ נַחֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֶ֑יהָ תְּ֝מֹגְגֶ֗נָּה בִּרְבִיבִ֥ים תְּבָרֵֽךְ׃ צִמְחָ֥הּ
verses.transliteration: raw·wêh tə·lā·me·hā na·ḥêṯ gə·ḏū·ḏe·hā tə·mō·ḡə·ḡen·nāh bir·ḇî·ḇîm tə·ḇā·rêḵ ṣim·ḥāh
verses.literal: You soak its furrows and level its ridges You soften it with showers and bless its growth

verses.original: עִ֭טַּרְתָּ שְׁנַ֣ת טוֹבָתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מַעְגָּלֶ֗יךָ יִרְעֲפ֥וּן דָּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.literal: You crown the year with Your bounty and Your paths overflow with plenty

verses.original: נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר יִ֭רְעֲפוּ גְּבָע֥וֹת תַּחְגֹּֽרְנָה׃ וְ֝גִ֗יל
verses.transliteration: nə·’ō·wṯ miḏ·bār yir·‘ă·p̄ū gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ taḥ·gō·rə·nāh wə·ḡîl
verses.literal: The pastures of the wilderness overflow the hills are robed with joy

verses.original: כָרִ֨ים׀ לָבְשׁ֬וּ הַצֹּ֗אן וַעֲמָקִ֥ים יַֽעַטְפוּ־ בָ֑ר יִ֝תְרוֹעֲע֗וּ אַף־ יָשִֽׁירוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḵā·rîm lā·ḇə·šū haṣ·ṣōn wa·‘ă·mā·qîm ya·‘aṭ·p̄ū- ḇār yiṯ·rō·w·‘ă·‘ū ’ap̄- yā·šî·rū
verses.literal: The pastures are clothed with flocks and the valleys are decked with grain They shout in triumph indeed they sing
